workflows.scenario: Start a simulator session, verify the dashboard is usable, and view checking account activity

steps.action: Navigate to the bank simulator home page and click GET STARTED NOW
steps.expected: The dashboard page loads at /bank-sim/ and a welcome dialog is displayed

steps.action: Observe the welcome dialog heading is present
steps.expected: Heading 'Welcome to the NGPF Bank Simulator' is visible

steps.action: Dismiss the welcome dialog by clicking Ok
steps.expected: The welcome dialog is no longer present and the dashboard content is visible

steps.action: Verify the checking account balance is displayed on the dashboard
steps.expected: A non-empty checking account balance value is visible on the dashboard

steps.action: Click VIEW ACCOUNT for the checking account
Verify the account activity table is visible with transaction data for the checking account
steps.expected: Account Activity heading is visible, Checking tab is present, the transaction table has Id/Date/Description/Amount/Balance column headers, and at least one transaction row is shown

workflows.test: generated_tests/www.ngpf.org/playwright_tests/tests/account-activity.spec.ts#displays checking account activity from the simulator dashboard
